author: Robert Hopman
description: scrap4rb reads Minitest test files and scores each test for size, branching, mocking, weak assertions and duplicated scaffolding. Per file it reports a refactor pressure, a remediation mode and an actionability class for an AI assistant. A Ruby port of the SCRAP algorithm by Robert C. Martin.

author: Satoru Nakamura
description: Builds a bigram search index in Ruby (with kana, old/new kanji and NFKC normalization), and queries it in Ruby or with a small browser runtime that returns the same results. Includes a Jekyll plugin and a CollectionBuilder preset.

author: Tomasz Mazur
description: A Rails Engine that provides a web UI for monitoring and analyzing PostgreSQL query performance. Mount pg_peek into your Rails application to introspect database queries, analyze pg_stat_statements data, track Active Job queries, and parse SQLcommenter tags for performance optimization.
